verdict.headline: Fed official calls for September rate hike as weak jobs data divides the market
verdict.label: HOLD — SPX 7,723 (−0.17%, off ATH); Dow 54,349 (+0.5%, new record); Nasdaq 26,373 (−0.8%); VIX 16.5 (+13%); 30Y 5.169% sole breach; September hike 63%; SHOP AH +18.7%; DIS AH +4.6%; BTC $64,589; 1-of-6 regime
verdict.rationale_short: The session split cleanly between blue chips and tech. ADP's 44K print (year's weakest, far below 65K consensus) pressured rates at 8:15am; Kashkari appeared on CNBC hours later calling for September hikes, sending September odds from 54% to 63%. The cross-current produced a Dow record (+0.5%, 54,349) while Nasdaq lost 0.8%. NVDA's SpaceX exclusive amplified the chip bifurcation: NVDA held ~$220, AMD −6.7% to $483.49. After hours, the clearest positives: Shopify +18.7% on Q2 revenue $3.58B (+34%), Disney +4.6% on EPS $2.06 (+28%) with Toy Story 5 crossing $1B at the global box office. Gold at $4,304 (+5.3%) is the macro tell — the market is pricing the Kashkari scenario: a hike into labor weakness. One breach remains: 30Y at 5.169%, 16.9bps above 5.00%. NFP Friday (consensus 80–91K) is the binary: below 80K isolates Kashkari and opens the 5.00% path; above 130K restores September above 70% and re-triggers the 30Y extension toward 5.28%.

trade_setups.thesis: 30Y at 5.169% — the sole breach at 16.9bps above 5.00%. September hike at 63% is 7 points from the 70% formal trigger. Friday's NFP print (consensus 80–91K) is the cleanest single data point to close both gaps or widen them. Below 80K: September falls well below 50%, Kashkari is isolated as a minority voice, 30Y has a path toward 5.00%, regime moves to 0-of-6. Above 130K: September pushes above 70%, a second formal breach triggers, 30Y extends toward 5.28%, and this week's rate-relief trade reverses in a single morning.
trade_setups.entry: Binary event makes pre-NFP directional positioning high-risk. 5.00% is the formal clearing level from below. The 5.169%–to–5.00% move requires NFP below 80K with no additional FOMC hawk before Friday open.
trade_setups.invalidation: A second FOMC official publicly endorses September before Friday morning, or headline NFP exceeds 130K.
trade_setups.horizon: 48 hours through NFP Aug 7; medium term through CPI Aug 13

bear_case: September hike odds jumped to 63% on Kashkari — 7 points from the 70% formal trigger. ADP 44K confirmed labor is softening, but three FOMC dissenters and Kashkari's public TV call mean the committee may hike into a slowing labor market. That is the stagflation setup: tariff goods-price stickiness plus AI infrastructure supply shocks push inflation while payrolls soften. Gold's 5.3% single-session surge on a day when the Dow hit a new record is not safe-haven buying — it is forward pricing of the Kashkari scenario explicitly. If Friday's NFP beats 130K, September crosses 70%, the 30Y re-prices toward 5.28%, and today's Dow record gets sold. An above-consensus print on Friday morning would invalidate this read within 90 minutes of the open.
